title: Meet Marcus
body: Marcus reconciles and releases every settled lien for a 4-clinic injury practice. Here is his Tuesday before and after this desk.

title: Every lien in one list
body: Attorney, lien holder, billed total, payments posted and balance for every lien, settled ones first. Click a row to open the ledger.

title: The lien's full history
body: From the signed LOP to the posted check, every step and note on the lien in order, so nobody has to dig through email.

title: Every closing statement, checked
body: When a firm sends its draft closing statement, the amount it lists for the practice is compared with the ledger and the signed lien resolution. Proposals and signed resolutions are tracked here too.

title: A statement that lists too little
body: The draft statement for lien 5163 lists $4,100 for the practice, but the signed resolution says $4,600. Marcus flags it before the firm disburses.

title: A short payment, caught first
body: Lien 5208 was paid $6,200 on an $11,400 bill with no reduction on file. It is flagged before any release goes out.

title: Days left before disbursement
body: The countdown shows when the attorney plans to pay out the settlement, so the most urgent lien is fixed first.

title: Marcus approves, then the release goes out
body: No balance is written off and no release letter reaches a law firm until Marcus approves it.

title: What this work costs today
body: Put in your own settled-lien volume and coordinator rate to compare today's cost with the desk.

title: How it would be built
body: Click any box to see what it does, what data passes through it and whether it stores patient data. A real build reads the EHR ledger and runs in the practice's own cloud.
